result.topic_en: Transformation properties of the theta-type ratio n/m under modular substitutions of M (continued fractions and linear fractional maps with pr+4qs=1), functional equations of the function p(t), and the theta transformation formula for sums of h^{an^2+2bn+c}.
result.transcription:
$p' = \frac{\sqrt[4]{\pi}}{\Pi(-\frac14)} = \frac{\Pi(\frac14)(\frac{4}{\pi})^{\frac34}}{4}$

Ist
$\frac{n}{m} = \frac{\mu(1-2e^{-M\pi}+2e^{-4M\pi}-2e^{-9M\pi}+..)^2}{\mu(1+2e^{-M\pi}+2e^{-4M\pi}+2e^{-9M\pi}+\;)^2}$

so kann man statt $M$ setzen

$= M^* \Big| \sqrt{M}.p[-M-] = \sqrt{M^*}.pM^*$ ungerade

wo $a, b, c, d, e$ u.s.w. eine beliebige ungerade Menge ganzer {+reeller+} Zahlen bedeuten; oder auch
$\frac{pM+2qi}{r+2sMi} [-= M-] \frac{M+2(qr-psMM)i}{rr+4ssMM}$
wo $p, q, r, s$ beliebige der Bedingung
$pr+4qs=1$
genüge Leistende Ganze {+reelle+} Zahlen sind.

Setzt man $Pe^{-\pi t} = pt$ \quad $P(e^{-\pi t}, e^{2\pi u}) = p(t,u)$
so ist
1) $p(t+2ik) = pt$
2) $pt = \frac{1}{\sqrt{t}}\cdot p\frac{1}{t}$ \quad so ist $e^{-\frac{uu}{4\pi t}}\sqrt{t}.p(t,u) = p(\frac{1}{t}, \frac{iu}{t})$

$pt^4 = p(t+i)^4 + (\frac12 p\frac14 t - \frac12 p(\frac14 t+i))^4$
$pt = \frac12 p\frac14 t + \frac12 p(\frac14 t+i)$
$pt + p(t+i) = 2p4t$
$p(t+i) = 2p4t - pt$
$= \frac{1}{\sqrt{t}}(p\frac{1}{4t} - p\frac{1}{t})$

$e^{-\pi} = h$ gesetzt
ist $\Sigma h^{ann+2bn+\gamma}$
$= \frac{h^{\gamma-\frac{bb}{\alpha}}}{\sqrt{\alpha}} \Sigma h^{\frac{1}{\alpha}nn + \frac{2bi}{\alpha}.n}$

$2ei+\frac{1}{M} = M'$ \quad $pM' = \sqrt{M}.pM$
$2di+\frac{1}{M'} = M''$ \quad $pM'' = \sqrt{M'}.pM'$
$2ci+\frac{1}{M''} = M'''$ \quad $pM''' = \sqrt{M''}.pM''$
$2bi+\frac{1}{M'''} = M^{IV}$ \quad etc
$2ai+\frac{1}{M^{IV}} = M^{V}$ \quad oder
etc
$pM^V = \sqrt{MM'M''M'''M^{IV}}.\,pM$
$pM^V = \sqrt{[2bi, 2ci, 2di, 2ei, M]}.pM$

methods.what: Value of p' expressed via the Gauss Pi (factorial) function at -1/4 and 1/4
Invariance of the theta-quotient n/m under replacing M by a continued fraction with purely imaginary even partial quotients (odd number of terms)
Transformation of theta function under the continued fraction substitution, depending on parity of the number of terms
Invariance under linear fractional (modular, level-4 type) substitution with pr+4qs=1
Jacobi imaginary transformation of theta function
Imaginary transformation for two-variable theta function
Jacobi quartic identity among theta functions
Expression of p(t+i) via the inversion formula
General theta transformation formula for quadratic exponent sums (Poisson summation)
Stepwise iteration of the transformation M -> 2ei+1/M and the product formula for theta multiplier
